claimChanges.claimText: ChatGPT is listed for Novosibirsk State University in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.
The Department of Cytology and Genetics page says students may not present materials wholly created by a generative model, or minimally technically corrected by the student, as their own work.

For final qualification work and other assignments covered by the Department of Cytology and Genetics page, students are obliged to verify generated content and disclose generative-model use in a methods section or declaration.
The Department of Cytology and Genetics page says students remain responsible for originality, accuracy, authorship of ideas, and academic honesty when using generative models.

The Department of Cytology and Genetics page says final qualification works undergo Antiplagiat checking, including automatic detection of generated text fragments, and that such fragments may be grounds for not admitting a student to defense.

NSU's Department of Cytology and Genetics says generative models may be used in final qualification work for idea inspiration, preliminary drafts with later revision, learning help, and routine technical tasks.
This staged crawl found department-level NSU AI-use rules, but did not find a central NSU-wide binding policy for generative AI use in official-source discovery.
